src/i18n/keys.gen.ts is byte-identical to a fresh generation (it already carries both sides' keys)

provenance.conclusion: Both sides' audited byte-versions are exactly the blobs in the index stages 2 and 3, and the union preserved every one of those value lines byte-identically - so the 18 values audited here are the values the two prior rounds audited, plus no other change.

checks.detail: 12 base + 5 branch + 1 main = 18 in both locales; no key added by both sides; no pre-existing key changed by either side; no key whose two sides disagree; no key removed; union parsed equal to base+additions and identical at raw line level.

checks.check: 2. the five branch keys are the audited values
checks.detail: playback_rate_option «{rate}x», volume «Громкость», playback_position «Позиция воспроизведения» read in the worktree; the en/ru files at HEAD hash to the audited pair recorded in f684e610b106-r4-ru.json, whose ui.chat.attachments block passed exactly these five delta keys, and the union keeps their raw lines byte-identical.

checks.check: 3. main's new key in the same voice
checks.detail: «Сохранённой копии тоже нет.» for 'The saved copy is gone too.' Genitive with нет, «тоже» carries 'too', «сохранённой копии» inflects the same term as the pre-existing saved_copy_label «Сохранённая копия» / copy_saved_path «Скопировать путь сохранённой копии», and it parallels the sibling file_missing_recovery «Файла по этому пути больше нет.». Distinct in meaning from that line (store copy vs origin path), so no collision with the base keys.

placeholder token sets identical en/ru on all 18 keys; no ICU plural/select/selectordinal in the namespace before or after (nothing here counts a noun); NFC, no control characters, no trailing/double spaces, no straight quotes, no '...', no space before punctuation, middle dot preserved in file_meta, and the only Latin residue is the intentional 'x' of {rate}x.

findings.problem: In ru this renders «0.5x» / «1.5x» with a Latin decimal point, against the ru guide's decimal-comma rule. The template is a bare ICU argument and the call site passes String(rate) (audio-attachment.tsx:232-234; keys.gen.ts types the argument as string), so intl-messageformat substitutes the value unchanged. Proven with the repo's own intl-messageformat: {rate}x + "0.5" -> "0.5x" (and a numeric 0.5 -> "0.5x", a bare argument is not number-formatted), while {rate, number}x -> "0,5x" in ru and "1,5x" in fr.
findings.suggested: Pass Number(rate) at the call site and make the template "{rate, number}x" in all seven catalogues (fr/es/vi carry the same defect; en/hi/zh-CN happen to be correct).
findings.not_a_translation_error: The catalogue value matches its own context note (keep the multiplier sign beside the number, do not spell 'times'), is byte-identical to English, and is unchanged from the branch head that round 4 passed - so this is not a union regression and does not block.

deviations.what: read_public_copy was not available for this file
deviations.detail: The sanctioned reader refused the working tree twice, verbatim: "refused: src/i18n/catalogues/{en,ru}/ui.chat.attachments.json differs from HEAD; commit the public copy before auditing it". The union is uncommitted by design, so the values were read from the working tree (read/JSON parse) and cross-checked against the committed side blobs above. Once the merge is committed the route becomes available; nothing here depends on an uncommitted reading that differs from an audited blob.

observations_outside_scope.what: i18n/ledger.json is still UU in the index
observations_outside_scope.detail: The merge is not commit-ready: the ledger conflict is unresolved alongside the eight locale catalogue conflicts. Out of scope for this namespace audit, reported so it is not mistaken for verified.

observations_outside_scope.what: the same number-formatting issue affects the other locales
observations_outside_scope.detail: playback_rate_option is «{rate}x» in all seven locales, so fr, es and vi render the same Latin decimal point; en, hi and zh-CN are unaffected by their own rules. A call-site fix covers all seven at once.

The en context union is also clean: 18 entries, main's entry and the five branch entries both present, no dropped or changed entry. The hand-union reflowed playback_rate_option's one-line "placeholders" object onto three lines (whitespace only, same value); context-parity passes.
